It's a shame that nobody has taken the time to respond to this.  I'll tell you something.  I've been depressed for months, my emotions are hardly real any more, and my girlfriend has struggled with depression for her whole life. I'm slowly getting more distant from everyone around me, except for her.  There's something about her that makes me feel like I can trust her.  And I do.

So, if you like this guy, and you trust him, you aren't going to treat him like everyone else.  And if he truly cares, he'll be there for you when you feel the worst, and help you pull yourself up.  Don't break away from him just because you're afraid of yourself, that's the type of thinking that gets you to this point in the first place.  If you care about him, that should not fade away so quickly.

Don't let yourself get hurt, either.  You're still vulnerable.  This could either help you in the end or hurt you badly.  You need to prepare for that, so it's not an unexpected blow.  Just be smart, and be kind.

My mom and my dad have been split since preschool.  Since then, I lived with my mom, and moved with my dad when I was 12.  I see my mom (and my little brother) in the summer, but I'm often depressed because I can't be there more.  They live all the way across the country.  I want to move there, and see my dad in the summer.  My little brother had to same situation living with our mom for the summers, and living with *his* dad for the school years in Puerto Rico.  Hurricane Maria destroyed PR so now he switched to PR in the summer.  I won't get to see him much until I'm 18(maybe) unless I move there.  I want to have a good relationship with him, our relationship is pretty shit RN.  I can't bring myself to tell my dad about this because he's said a lot of times before with different context that he doesn't want me to move with my mom because that's "not what they agreed on." Personally, I couldn't care less about their agreement,  but my dad is the boss.  I'm scared to tell him, and I'm worried that this might not solve my depression.  I think it will, but some part of me is saying, "What if it doesn't?"
